answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in spiral and whisper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the vine graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1961 impostors cost 1279 times the honest price and take 18 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
